rationale: Anchor cfl_c001p300_d000p420 (chi1.3 d_h0.42) tops the measured d-ladder at protr_peak 1.84 but is a RIGID growthless ball; the campaign is growth_driven. Graft the growth machinery that already exists in the WK recipe (shape_to_chem curvature feedback, morphogen_growth_3d, divide_3d) onto the strong Turing anchor and ask whether growth AMPLIFIES protrusion past 1.84 or ruptures it. In parallel push the pure-chemistry drive (chi up, d_h past 0.42) to find whether 1.84 is the chemistry crest. All candidates are single-variable edits or operator grafts off the rebuildable MINI_coral_fixed seed recipe, in okuda vocabulary only.

candidates.hypothesis: re-measures the growthless anchor as this batch's baseline
candidates.falsifier: protr_peak drifts >0.15 from 1.84 -> baseline non-reproducible, treat batch as uncontrolled

candidates.hypothesis: gentle morphogen-driven growth on the strong Turing field lets protrusions extend
candidates.falsifier: protr_peak <= anchor -> growth does not amplify at low rate

candidates.hypothesis: WK-rate growth on the strong anchor: growth-dose midpoint
candidates.prediction: protr_peak rises monotone with rate above R2.1
candidates.falsifier: non-monotone or TIER-1 rupture -> growth-rate ceiling below 0.03

candidates.hypothesis: strong growth: dose top end / rupture falsifier
candidates.prediction: protr_peak peaks then rolls off or mesh ruptures
candidates.falsifier: still rising and sound -> growth ceiling not yet reached

candidates.hypothesis: curvature->chemistry feedback alone (no growth) sharpens protrusion tips
candidates.prediction: protr_peak > anchor via mechanochemical positive feedback
candidates.falsifier: protr_peak ~= anchor -> feedback inert without growth

candidates.hypothesis: full mechanochemical loop (feedback + growth) on strong Turing = the campaign's target object
candidates.prediction: protr_peak highest of Track A, sound
candidates.falsifier: below R2.2 -> feedback and growth do not synergize

candidates.hypothesis: high feedback gain drives runaway protrusion
candidates.prediction: protr_peak > R2.5 or mesh ruptures (upper edge of feedback)
candidates.falsifier: protr_peak <= R2.5 sound -> gain saturates before rupture

candidates.hypothesis: cell division on the growing sheet: does proliferation dilute or sustain protrusion
candidates.prediction: protr_peak <= R2.2 (division re-tiles tips, mixing event)
candidates.falsifier: protr_peak > R2.2 -> division adds tip material, sustains protrusion

candidates.hypothesis: push chemotactic coupling above anchor chi1.3

candidates.prediction: protr_peak rolls off or mesh destabilizes
candidates.falsifier: still rising and sound -> chi ceiling above 2.0

candidates.hypothesis: extend the measured d_h ladder (0.22->0.42 monotone) past 0.42
candidates.prediction: protr_peak > 1.84 if the ladder has not crested
candidates.falsifier: protr_peak <= 1.84 -> d_h crest at 0.42, adopt anchor

candidates.hypothesis: far past-peak d_h bracket to confirm the crest
candidates.falsifier: protr_peak >= R2.10 -> ladder still climbing, extend further
